'''Ranch''' is a Pal training structure that allows compatible Pals to graze and periodically generate items while assigned to a base. Ranches function automatically once compatible Pals are deployed at a base, however pals with multiple work suitabilities treat Ranch grazing as a **secondary task** and may leave temporarily to perform other assigned jobs before returning.

==Unlocking==
* [[Technology]] tier: 5
* Cost: 2 Technology Points

==Crafting==
{{Crafting Recipe
|product = Ranch
|yield = 1
|workbench = Build Menu
|workload = 150
|ingredients = Wood*30; Stone*20; Fiber*30
}}

==Drops==
Different [[Pal]]s drop different things while grazing the ranch. Note that as of v0.3.1.0, there are no pals with a {{i|farming}} level over 1 without the use of the [[Pal Essence Condenser]].

{{Farming_Table}}

==Usage==
===Function===
The Ranch allows certain Pals to graze and periodically drop items while assigned to a base. Only Pals with compatible grazing behavior will use the Ranch.

Up to four Pals may graze in a single Ranch at a time. Pals with multiple work suitabilities may leave the Ranch to perform higher-priority tasks and return when available. Work Speed bonuses affect grazing efficiency.

Item drops appear within the Ranch area and must be collected manually or transported by Pals with the {{i|Transporting}} suitability.

===Placement===
The Ranch can be placed anywhere within a base’s build area. Only Pals assigned to the base associated with the Ranch will use it.

Multiple Ranches may be built in a single base to increase total grazing capacity.
